primer: NIKE Inc (NYSE: NKE) is the world's largest athletic footwear and apparel company ($46.40B FY2026 revenue; 73,000 employees) . Under CEO Elliott Hill's "Win Now" reset, NIKE is unwinding its 2020–2023 direct-to-consumer overreach, repairing ties with Dick's Sporting Goods and Foot Locker, and refocusing on performance running . Early green shoots appeared in North America wholesale (+9% in Q1 FY2027), yet Greater China (-26% CC), NIKE Direct (-8%), Converse (-28%), and FCF ($2.18B vs. $2.41B dividend) remain under pressure . At Friday's November 13, 2026 close of $37.99 ($56.43B market cap; 25.54x Forward P/E), we assign WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (`TIER_3` Watchlist) for new capital and HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP for the existing 74.5773 shares ($2,833.19; 3.19% weight) in Robinhood .
